Supplier — Edit

Suppliers are businesses or individuals from whom you purchase goods, services, or other items for your business operations.

Use this form to create a new supplier or edit existing supplier details. Maintaining accurate supplier information helps you track purchases, manage payables, and organize your business relationships.

Each supplier can have their own currency, payment terms, and contact information. You can also assign a unique code to each supplier for easy identification in transactions.

The information you enter here will appear on purchase invoices, purchase orders, and other documents related to this supplier.

Name

Enter the supplier's name as it should appear on all transactions and reports.

This name will be displayed in dropdown lists throughout the system and on documents like purchase invoices and purchase orders.

Code

Enter a unique supplier code to identify this supplier quickly in the system.

Supplier codes are optional but recommended for businesses with many suppliers. They allow you to search by code or name in dropdown menus.

Common examples include vendor numbers, abbreviations, or alphanumeric codes like 'SUPP001' or 'ACME-SUP'.

Credit limit

Set the maximum amount you can owe this supplier at any time. This helps manage cash flow and purchasing limits.

The system will warn you when creating purchase transactions that would exceed this limit.

Leave blank for unlimited credit. Monitor your credit usage through the Suppliers tab summary.

Currency

Assign a foreign currency to suppliers operating in a different currency from your base currency. By default, all supplier accounts are in your base currency. Selecting a foreign currency will issue all transactions (purchase orders, invoices, debit notes) in that currency.

Note: This option appears only if foreign currencies are created in the system.

Address

Enter the supplier's complete business address for correspondence and documentation.

This address automatically populates when creating new Purchase Invoices, Purchase Orders, or Debit Notes for this supplier.

Include street address, city, state/province, postal code, and country for complete records.

Email

Enter the supplier's primary email address for business communications.

Use this email for sending purchase orders, payment remittances, and other supplier correspondence.

Ensure this is the correct email address for accounts receivable or order processing at the supplier.

Division

Assign this supplier to a specific division for divisional reporting and cost center tracking.

All purchases from this supplier will be allocated to the selected division for profitability analysis.

This field only appears if divisions are enabled under Settings → Divisions.

Control account

Select a custom control account if this supplier should use a different accounts payable account than the default.

Custom control accounts help segregate different supplier types, such as trade creditors vs other creditors, or domestic vs international suppliers.

This field only appears if custom control accounts for suppliers have been created under Settings → Control Accounts.

Inactive

Mark this supplier as inactive to hide them from dropdown selection lists while preserving all historical transactions.

Use this for suppliers you no longer purchase from. Inactive suppliers can still be viewed and their transactions remain in reports.

You can reactivate a supplier at any time by unchecking this box.
